login_hint: Scan with WeChat and confirm in the mini program. New users get an account automatically
existing_user_desc: Sign in with your username and password first, then bind WeChat when prompted. Scanning here creates a separate, empty account without your membership.
existing_user_action: Existing users: sign in with password →
confirm_in_mini: Tap Confirm in the mini program on your phone
use_password: Existing users: sign in with password
password_tip: After signing in with a password you will need to bind WeChat; afterwards only WeChat sign-in works
bind_desc: To protect your account this site now signs in with WeChat. Scan with your own WeChat to bind it; afterwards this account signs in only through that WeChat and the old password stops working.
bind_hint: Scan with WeChat and confirm binding in the mini program
bind_warning: One WeChat can bind only one account. Use your own WeChat. If you scanned on the sign-in page earlier, the empty account it created (starting with wx_) is merged into this one when you bind; if the mini program says this WeChat is bound to another account and won't continue, contact customer support.
unbind_success: Unbound. The user can sign in with the password once to bind again
